purpose: Project-symbolic D1-D11 vertical navigation model anchored at the North / Axis Gate. D4 is the ordinary world map; D5 is the Door/first-heaven threshold; D6-D11 ascend toward North of North; D3-D1 descend through roots, Swamp/disintegration and deepest lower-plane imagery.
boundary: This D1-D11 scheme is spiritual/project-symbolic scaffolding, not a claim about physical dimensions, altitude, underground geography, cosmology, sovereignty or M-theory. M-theory is only a structural analogy because eleven-dimensional physics provides a familiar example of a description with additional dimensions; no physical equivalence is asserted.

anchor.label: North / Axis Gate
anchor.geographic_reference: High Arctic / North Pole visual threshold north of Greenland
anchor.relation: D4 Earth-side geography enters the D5 project-symbolic Door here. The Axis/Ladder continues upward and downward from the same threshold.

up.meaning: integration / growth / fruit / virtue / light / life
up.note: These are symbolic markers for constructive spiritual growth, not measurable physical forces.

down.meaning: debt / separation / hardening / disintegration / burial / unresolved consequence
down.note: These are project-symbolic diagnostic markers, not judgments about populations or physical locations.

directional_law.bidirectional: The Door/Ladder is not one-way. Descent and ascent share the same Axis. Genesis 28 is a comparative scriptural parallel because angels ascend and descend on the same stairway; the project additionally uses seed/burial/growth imagery to describe transformation.

levels.label: D1 · Deep Lower Plane
levels.description: Deepest current project-symbolic lower state. A placeholder for hell, terminal separation, closed-loop disintegration and the farthest descent from integration. It is not literal underground geography or a claim about an afterlife location.

levels.label: D2 · Swamp / Disintegration
levels.description: Project diagnostic layer for Swamp/subculture, debt, opacity, extraction, broken relations and disintegration. It describes mechanisms and project metaphors, not peoples, nations or physical terrain.

levels.label: D3 · Roots of Ash
levels.description: The immediate sub-layer beneath ordinary Earth: roots, ash, burial, chronology, ancestry, unresolved causes and stored consequence. It is the downward root system of the Axis Tree and the nearest lower plane to D4.

levels.label: D4 · Earth / World Map
levels.description: The default Atlas layer: countries, cities, populations, institutions, empirical networks and sourced relations. D4 is the only level in this scaffold treated as ordinary geographic map space.

levels.label: D5 · North Door / First Heaven
levels.symbol: Door / North bubble / seed junction / Ladder mouth
levels.description: The North bubble is D5: the first spiritual threshold above the ordinary D4 map. The Door and Ladder meet here. Seeds, virtues, angels and light can be represented as ascending markers; debt, ash and disintegration as descending markers. D5 is a junction, not a country or physical altitude.

levels.label: D6 · Spiral Ladder
levels.symbol: Jacob's ladder / winding stair / spiral ascent
levels.description: First full ascent above the Door: the Axis as spiral ladder or winding staircase. It represents movement, transformation and increasing integration rather than a literal physical dimension.

levels.label: D7 · Tree of Life
levels.description: The ladder resolves into the living Tree: seed to root to trunk to branches to fruit. Wheat, potato and spiral motifs function here as project markers of successful growth and multiplication.

levels.label: D8 · Garden / Rooms
levels.description: A more integrated project-symbolic plane of Garden, House and Rooms: differentiated spaces held inside one larger order. This is conceptual topology, not latitude/longitude.

levels.label: D9 · Angels / Seeds of Light
levels.symbol: angels / flow / seeds of light / movement
levels.description: A higher movement layer reserved for angelic ascent/descent, seeds of light, Spirit/flow and other project markers of transmission between integrated levels. Content should be added only when sourced to project canon.

levels.label: D10 · Heaven / Crown
levels.description: Near-summit project-symbolic plane for Heaven/Crown/Throne-facing integration. It is intentionally sparse until durable canonical material is assigned to it.

levels.label: D11 · North of North
levels.symbol: North of North / source / perfected garden
levels.description: Highest current project-symbolic navigation plane: North of North, source-facing canon and perfected-garden imagery. It receives no invented Earth coordinate and is not asserted to be the physical eleventh dimension of M-theory.

navigation_rule: Start at D4. The North bubble is D5 and is the Door/Ladder junction. Upward movement follows D6-D11 through spiral, Tree, Garden, light/angelic flow, Heaven and North of North. Downward movement returns through D3-D1 via roots/ash, Swamp/disintegration and deepest lower-plane imagery.
content_rule: The dimensions are containers, not excuses to manufacture content. A level may remain sparse. New nodes belong only where project canon, evidence, chronology or a clearly labeled interpretation gives them a durable reason to be there.
analogy_note: M-theory's use of an eleven-dimensional framework is a structural analogy only. In physics, eleven-dimensional supergravity appears as a low-energy limit related to M-theory; this Atlas does not claim its spiritual D1-D11 scaffold is physical M-theory.
